name: movie-tickets
description: Full-stack online movie ticket booking system (React + TypeScript client, Express + TypeScript API)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @movie-tickets/client && npm run build -w @movie-tickets/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @movie-tickets/client && npm run lint -w @movie-tickets/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @movie-tickets/client && npm run typecheck -w @movie-tickets/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @movie-tickets/server && npm run test -w @movie-tickets/client
